title: K-only end-to-end timing reconciliation
motivation: Short shared-runner measurements of the exact-theta+C plus K-lookup candidate disagree in sign or show only a few percent effect. A longer paired protocol is required before any performance conclusion.
question: Does the derivative-consistent exact-theta+C plus K-lookup provider reduce total Reference Richards solve CPU under a longer paired timing protocol?

timing_policy.compiler: gfortran -O3 without runtime checks or floating-point traps
timing_policy.order: alternate analytical->Klookup and Klookup->analytical by repetition
timing_policy.primary_statistic: median of paired Klookup/analytical CPU ratios
